## Spark Plug Problem

### Claim

Average Lifetime = 28000

### Hypotheses

$H_0$: $\mu = 28000$

$H_A$: $\mu < 28000$

```{r}
xbar <- 26040 # sample mean
sigma <- 12894 # population stdev
n <- 27 # sample size
mu.0 <- 28000 # null value
stderr <- sigma / sqrt(n)
alpha <- 0.05 # significance level
```

## Analyze Data

Find z-score

```{r}
z <- (xbar - mu.0) / stderr
```

```{r}
pnorm(z)
```

## Web Browser Hypothesis Test

```{r}
p <- 0.99
```

```{r}
n <- 1014
phat <- 984 / n
se <- sqrt(phat * (1 - phat) / n)
alpha <- 0.05
```

```{r}
zstar <- qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) # Critical Value
me <- se * zstar
conf_itv <- c(phat - me, phat + me)
```
